purpose: The CA_Law_Enforcement_Procedures_Specialist carries the statutory and regulatory standards governing California law enforcement conduct — use of force, body cameras, domestic violence response, arrest authority, officer records, and POST training requirements. This Citizen exists because the steward's case involves multiple law enforcement encounters where procedural compliance is a central issue.

bound_directly.popular_name: POST basic training and certification standards

domain.subject_matter: Law enforcement procedures: use of force (Pen. Code §835a), body cameras (§832.18), DV response (§13701), arrest authority (§836), officer records (§832.7), RIPA racial profiling (Gov. Code §12525.2), POST training standards (11 CCR §§1001-1082)
